title: IS marketplace authoring tier — 3 universal folds + universalFolds composition
description: The shared foundation every per-contract authoring schema (skill-frontmatter, plugin-manifest, agent-definition, mcp-config, hook-config, marketplace-catalog) inherits BY REFERENCE. Per ISEDC Session 8 charter DR-044 decision D7 (intent-eval-lab/000-docs/044-AT-DECR-isedc-council-session-8-sak-charter-2026-06-09.md), the marketplace tier is decomposed so that the THREE universal folds (deprecationRegistry, securityChecks, disclosureMarkers) are uniform across all six contracts, while `requiredFields` is specialized PER CONTRACT (a plugin-manifest's required set is not a skill's). The `universalFolds` $def is the allOf composition of exactly those three; each per-contract schema $refs it (by reference, not inline copy) and supplies its own `requiredFields` separately. The folds are intentionally open-world (no additionalProperties:false) — allOf composition requires each branch to tolerate fields the other branches add; closed-world checks belong in the per-contract schemas.
$comment: PREDICATE valid_universalFolds(artifact) := deprecationRegistry(artifact) ∧ securityChecks(artifact) ∧ disclosureMarkers(artifact). Monotone; order-independent. A per-contract schema composes valid_C(artifact) := requiredFields_C(artifact) ∧ universalFolds(artifact) ∧ upstreamBase_C(artifact) ∧ overlay_C(artifact). securityChecks is UNIVERSAL-IMMUTABLE (D7(b)): add-only, never overridable, never subtracted. `requiredFields` was REMOVED from this foundation in the D7 refactor — it lives in each per-contract schema. Co-located changelogs: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md.

deprecationRegistry.$comment: UNIVERSAL FOLD 1/3 — field-deprecation migrations. Evolves via autonomous validator patch (SCHEMA_CHANGELOG NON-NEGOTIABLES item 6). A present deprecated key fails the fold; the message names the replacement. CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § deprecationRegistry. v1.0.0-draft: compatible-with → compatibility; when_to_use → description.

securityChecks.$comment: UNIVERSAL FOLD 2/3 — UNIVERSAL-IMMUTABLE per DR-044 D7(b). Supply-chain hardening (CISO-owned). Add-only; never overridable by a per-contract schema; never subtracted. A CI meta-test asserts every contract $refs this fold by reference. name must not be a reserved word and must not contain XML angle brackets; description must not contain XML tags or shell-substitution sequences. CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § securityChecks. v1.0.0-draft.

disclosureMarkers.$comment: UNIVERSAL FOLD 3/3 — progressive disclosure / token-economy (Karpathy-axis). description is bounded to a token budget (1536 chars). Only strings are constrained (non-strings pass — type is enforced by the per-contract schema, not this foundation). CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § disclosureMarkers. v1.0.0-draft.

universalFolds.$comment: COMPOSITION — allOf of the three universal folds. Every per-contract schema $refs THIS (by reference). Adding/removing a fold is an architectural change requiring ISEDC review. CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § universalFolds (composition). v1.0.0-draft.
